steps.caption: Sit together
steps.voice: Hi, friends. I'm your music teacher. Let's get ready to play together.
steps.parentCue: Sit beside your child, in front of the keys

steps.caption: Sit in the middle
steps.voice: Sit up tall, right in the middle of the piano.
steps.parentCue: Stand the phone on the music stand, facing you both

steps.caption: You play
steps.voice: You are the piano player today.

steps.caption: Grown-up helps
steps.voice: Grown-up, you are the helper. Point, cheer, and guide a finger when needed.
steps.parentCue: You never need to play perfectly

steps.caption: Find two black keys
steps.voice: Find two black keys, side by side, in the middle of your piano.
steps.parentCue: Use the pair nearest the middle

steps.caption: This is C
steps.voice: Just to the left of the two black keys lives C.

steps.caption: Our home key
steps.voice: This C in the middle is our home key. Put one finger on it.
steps.parentCue: This is middle C. Check it is the one in the middle

steps.caption: Listen: C
steps.voice: Listen. This is how C sounds.

steps.caption: I listen
steps.voice: I listen for your notes. When you play the glowing key, I hear it.
steps.parentCue: The app listens for single notes through the microphone

steps.caption: We played it
steps.voice: Grown-up, if the microphone is off, tap We played it after each turn.
steps.parentCue: No microphone? You tap the button after your child plays

steps.caption: Soft round hand
steps.voice: Make a soft round hand, like holding a little ball.

steps.caption: Finger numbers
steps.voice: Your fingers have numbers. Your thumb is number one.
steps.parentCue: 1 is the thumb, 5 is the little finger

steps.caption: One to five
steps.voice: Wiggle each one with me. One, two, three, four, five.
steps.parentCue: Touch each finger as you count

steps.caption: The glowing key
steps.voice: When a key glows, that's the key to play.

steps.caption: Falling blocks
steps.voice: Blocks fall down to the keys. When a block lands, play.
steps.parentCue: Coral blocks are your child's notes, blue ones are yours

steps.caption: Watch
steps.voice: When you see the eye, it's watch time. Hands on your knees.

steps.caption: Watch
steps.voice: Watch my thumb play C.

steps.caption: Your turn
steps.voice: When you see the hand, it's your turn. I wait for you.

steps.caption: Together
steps.voice: When you see two friends, we play together, at the same time.

steps.caption: Bear low, bird high
steps.voice: Low keys, on the left, sound like a big bear.
steps.parentCue: High keys are on the right, for the little bird

steps.caption: Bear! Tap down low
steps.voice: Tap any low key, down on the left.
steps.parentCue: Any key on the left counts

steps.caption: Bird! Tap up high
steps.voice: Now the little bird. Tap any high key, up on the right.
steps.parentCue: Any key on the right counts

steps.caption: Tap the beat
steps.voice: When the circle grows, tap any key. Tap, tap, tap.
steps.parentCue: Any key is fine. Tap with your child at first

steps.caption: Pause or stop
steps.voice: Grown-up, pause at the top any time. Close stops the class.
steps.parentCue: We save your place, so you can come back later

steps.caption: Stars
steps.voice: At the end of each class, you get stars for playing together.

steps.caption: Mistakes are fine
steps.voice: A different key just makes a new sound. That's fine. We try again.
steps.parentCue: There is never a fail sound. Cheer for trying

steps.caption: Your first note
steps.voice: Now your very first note. Find C, our home key.

steps.caption: Your turn!
steps.voice: Your turn. One finger, gentle press on C.
steps.parentCue: Point to C if your child needs help

steps.caption: You did it!
steps.voice: I heard C! You played your very first note.
steps.voiceMicOff: You played your very first note. Hooray for you two.

steps.caption: Ready to play
steps.voice: That's how Little Duet works. Now let's play a song together.
steps.parentCue: Pick a song from Home to start your first class
